claims.claim: bullfrogs stay inactive until water nears 15 °C
claims.note: Secondary only. The VHS account relays it: adults generally remain inactive until water temperatures approach 15 °C (Harding, 1997).
Secondary only. The VHS account relays it: males defend roughly circular territories 2–5 m in diameter (Harding, 1997).

claims.claim: males on floating territories 2–5 m across, inactive until the water nears 15 °C
claims.note: Secondary only, as above. The relay says 'roughly circular'; 'floating' is not in it.
